name: Galleonaire
description: Take on Galleonaire on iPhone and Apple Watch. Answer fifteen increasingly difficult questions for a fictional million-galleon prize. Explore 600 questions about Harry Potter books, films and the wider wizarding world, with forty questions at every prize level. Correct answers move straight to the next question, with no confirmation or Next Question button. Use Fifty-Fifty, Ask the Audience and Swap Question, protect guaranteed prizes, or walk away with your winnings. Enjoy original magical-library artwork, dramatic game-over music and a celebratory million-galleon fanfare. Both devices support independent offline games, a saved highest prize, native VoiceOver controls, adjustable original music, sound effects and haptics. In Settings, Background Music and Sound Effects each have their own on/off switch and independent 0-100% volume slider; set either to 0 or switch it off for silence. Individual sound previews and a separate Haptics switch help you choose what suits you. Every fresh launch opens the main menu without restoring an unfinished game. Independent fan-made quiz, not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors, publishers or film studios referenced. Galleons are fictional points with no monetary value. No advertising or analytics.
whatToTest:
THANK YOU FOR TESTING GALLEONAIRE
Thank you for giving your time to test Galleonaire and for sharing your feedback. Your comments are helping improve the game for blind, low-vision and sighted players alike.

ABOUT THE GAME
Galleonaire is an independent, fan-made Harry Potter trivia game for iPhone and Apple Watch. Answer 15 increasingly difficult questions for a fictional million-galleon prize. Choose from four answers, use Fifty-Fifty, Ask the Audience or Swap Question, and play offline. There are 600 questions, with 40 at each prize level. Galleons are game points, not real money. There is no account, advertising or purchase needed to play.

MAKE THE AUDIO SUIT YOU
Open Settings to customise your listening experience. Background Music and Sound Effects each have their own on/off switch and independent volume slider from 0 to 100%. You can make either quieter, switch either off completely, or turn both off for silent gameplay. A volume of 0 also means off. You can preview the individual sounds at your chosen sound-effects volume. Haptics have a separate on/off switch. These controls are available on iPhone and Apple Watch; please also test settings syncing between paired devices.

WHAT IS NEW
- 150 additional questions: ten at every prize level, for 600 in total. Recent-question history reduces early repeats.
- Clearer book and film references, including the Dobby/Neville Gillyweed distinction.
- Revised VoiceOver focus on the new question after a correct answer. The previous answer and explanation now have their own separate item above it.
- Reshuffled answers on every question. The correct A/B/C/D position does not repeat on consecutive draws, including swaps and new games.
- Original enchanted-library artwork, framed question cards and a brief green correct/red incorrect edge glow. Reduce Motion or Dim Flashing Lights suppresses the animated glow; text and symbols still identify the result.

PLEASE TEST
1. With VoiceOver on, answer several questions correctly. It should read the new question first, without announcing a random answer. Swipe left to read the previous explanation separately, then swipe right back to the question and answers. Please check both iPhone and Apple Watch.
2. Play, swap and restart repeatedly. Check answer positions, scoring, Fifty-Fifty and audience percentages. Report any repeated question, unclear wording or factual error, including the complete question and relevant book or film.
3. Check the artwork, green/red feedback, contrast and large text. Repeat with Reduce Motion and Dim Flashing Lights enabled; the result glow should not animate.
4. Try both audio switches and volume sliders, including 0% and 100%, individual sound previews, haptics and paired-device settings sync. Check that music and effects can each be silenced independently and that your choices are remembered.
5. Try winning, losing, Walk Away, Main Menu and Play Again. A fresh launch should keep your records and settings but start at the menu.

Please send feedback through TestFlight with your device, OS version, what happened and the steps to reproduce it. Screenshots are welcome where useful. Physical-device VoiceOver feedback is especially valuable. Thank you again for helping make Galleonaire better!
reviewNotes: No account, password, purchase, advertising or external service is needed to play. Start with New Game. The Watch app is embedded in the iPhone build and is playable independently. In-game galleons are fictional score points, not money, gambling or redeemable prizes. The app does not request Health, contacts, location, microphone or tracking access. Review both visual and native VoiceOver gameplay. The expanded question bank contains independently written trivia with source notes. Artwork and audio are original and the app makes no claim of official franchise affiliation.
